{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Confirm: are there any rows with revenue == '999999.99'? 
internal_test_orders = df[df['revenue'] == '999999.99']
print(f"Number of internal test orders (revenue == '999999.99'): {len(internal_test_orders)}")

# Since none exist, we proceed to clean revenue column
# Convert revenue from string to float, removing commas
# First, check for any non-numeric or malformed values
print(f"Unique revenue values: {df['revenue'].unique()}")

# Clean revenue: remove commas and convert to float
df['revenue_clean'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '', regex=False).astype(float)

# Now filter for completed orders and exclude any internal test orders (even if none exist)
completed_filtered = df[(df['status'] == 'completed') & (df['revenue_clean'] != 999999.99)]

# Compute total revenue from completed orders
total_revenue = completed_filtered['revenue_clean'].sum()

print(f"Total revenue from completed orders (excluding internal test orders): {total_revenue:,.2f}")"}
